an7.76:1.1: Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hoti.
an7.76:1.7: ubhayāni kho pan' assa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anuvyañjanaso,
an7.76:1.8: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an7.76:1.9: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.76:1.10: Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hotī
